Strategy: Reward bins whose post-placement residual lies between one and two item sizes, leaving room for exactly one more item of the same size. This targets reusable residuals rather than tightest fits, but the window may often be empty and the bonus may distort otherwise good tight choices.
```python
def priority(item, bins):
    return [-(r - item) + (20 if r - item >= item and r - item < 2 * item else 0) for r in bins]
```
